Provisions recorded so far

Each row is research, not a legal finding. Encoding stays blocked until the source, interpretation, tests and an independent review are recorded.

Candidate provisions, locators and review state
ProvisionRecorded locatorRecorded interpretationEffect assessmentEncoding status
P-01 Definitions and discriminationArticle 1The Law defines disability, the disability card and discrimination, including distinctions that prejudice rights or equal enjoyment of rights.Not assessedBlocked
P-02 Equality and non-discriminationArticles 2-3The Law aims to secure rights and services and requires equality and non-discrimination across legislation, policies and development programmes.Not assessedBlocked
P-03 Communication and information rightsArticle 7The State is to secure expression and opinion through Braille, sign language and other communication means, and the right to request, receive and transmit information on an equal footing.Not assessedBlocked
P-04 Accessible cultural materialsArticle 20(2)The State is to provide literary and cultural materials in available forms, including electronic texts, sign language, Braille, audio and multimedia.Not assessedBlocked
P-05 Adapted environment and facilitiesArticles 22-23The Law recognises a right to an adapted environment and requires engineering standards for public facilities, applying to the government and private sectors unless exempted.Not assessedBlocked

Open interpretation questions

  • AE-LAW29-01 Whether Articles 7 and 20 apply to government websites, apps and digital services, or only to the formats and services expressly listed, requires legal review.

    Risk: High; Status: Unresolved; Needs: Qualified legal review; Recorded category: digital_scope

  • AE-LAW29-02 The implementing Cabinet decision and technical standards contemplated by Article 23 are not captured; their content and current status are unresolved.

    Risk: High; Status: Unresolved; Needs: Source capture; Recorded category: implementing_instrument

  • AE-LAW29-03 The relationship between this 2006 Law, Cabinet Resolution 43/2018 and the 2024 National Digital Accessibility Policy needs a consolidated reading.

    Risk: High; Status: Unresolved; Needs: Qualified legal review; Recorded category: instrument_relationship
